communications.subject: HomeStitch Custom Décor — Order #HS-4520
communications.body: Thank you for your custom curtain order! Custom Blackout Curtains (84x52, Navy Blue, Pair). Total: $275.00. Estimated delivery: [10-14 business days]. We'll send a shipping notification when your curtains are ready.

communications.subject: Order status — #HS-4520
communications.body: My curtains were supposed to arrive by now. Can you please provide an update on my order?

communications.subject: RE: Order status — #HS-4520
communications.body: Thank you for contacting HomeStitch Custom Décor. We are currently experiencing production delays due to supply chain issues. We will update you as soon as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience.

communications.subject: URGENT: Where are my curtains? Order #HS-4520
communications.body: It has been 3 weeks and I have not received my curtains or any update. Please ship my order or issue a full refund immediately.

communications.subject: No merchant response
communications.body: No response was sent to the customer's second inquiry. The cardholder also attempted to call [30 days after purchase] and the phone number was disconnected. The merchant's website now displays 'temporarily closed for maintenance'.
